summary: DungeonContext with brief section 19's fields and a signature folded over every one of them, so the same context always yields the same rooms and a different owner or tier never collides; plus the reward budget repeated farming draws down.

coordination.notes: building.rs: exactly one field appended at the END of BuildingInstance's field list (stored_value, serde(default)) plus its initialiser in place_building. Other lanes appending their own fields to the same tail merge with this. Everything else S9 owns lives in strategy/dungeon.rs, including the impl ExpeditionState block. No change to tick.rs, expedition.rs, save_migration.rs (the new field is nested inside ExpeditionState.buildings, so EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS is unaffected).
